title: Unknown construction / unknown occupancy combinations
text:
Unknown construction / unknown occupancy combinations

Construction and occupancy codes to used to represent cases in which the construction
 class and/or unknown occupancy type are unknown.
For onshore locations, construction class code 100 represents unknown construction, while
 occupancy class code 300 represents unknown occupancy. For offshore locations,
 construction class code 800 represents unknown construction, while occupancy class code
 900 represents unknown occupancy.

If you try to import a location with a blank construction or occupancy code, 
ImportExpress
 rejects the location. However, you
 can specify default construction and occupancy class codes for
 
*.csv
 imports. See the "Defaults tab" topic in the main 
Touchstone
 Help.
 See "Location Basic Building Fields" for information about the basic building characteristics of
 locations.

| Construction class code A | Construction class code B | Occupancy class code | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Imports successfully. During analysis, Touchstone assigns General Commercial (311) or Unknown Offshore Asset Occupancy

 model, refer to the model documentation on the . Client Portal . |
